stages.headline: In Pascal's triangle each number is the sum of the two above it.
stages.headlineEnglish: In Pascal's triangle each number is the sum of the two above it.

stages.headline: The general term is Tₖ₊₁ = Cₙᵏ aⁿ⁻ᵏ bᵏ; e.g. the coefficient of x³ in (x + 2)⁵ is C₅² · 2² = 40.
